semantics.shared_link: One process-owned budget per full-duplex direction. semantics.supervisor: Create a clean spawned supervisor before any HE key. Only its public specification list is serialized. Launch fixed pinned workers from this HE-secret-free process, reject duplicate startup/replacement, enforce explicit readiness/termination deadlines and preserve every process result. No network message selects executable/library/config/trust anchor.

semantics.private_custody: No HE/AES/signing-secret payload, environment or artifact. Owner keys never passed through process launch API. Actual HE process-custody inspection remains future frozen cohort.
semantics.scope_limits: Public prototype plumbing only; no full coordinator, real-key execution, hardware authority, private-side-channel assurance or positive paper result

public_gate.units: Small actual TCP/socket and public echo subprocess fixtures, no valid-HE-pair claim; preserve sources, invocation and every failure before correction
